answer: Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime. The lantern holds work receipts rather than names, so the nebula of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
